features.label: Simple lighting controls

extras.title: IR23 remote
extras.text: Every simple lighting control on this page (in-line and standalone microwave / passive infrared occupancy sensors with daylight harvesting or daylight hold-off) is controlled by the IR23 handheld remote pictured beside the table. The luminaire pages list it as RC-REMOTE-IR23 (for simple lighting controls / for microwave occ sensors).
